computed_summary.closest_simple_flow_competitor: Before & After Video Maker by Qvyshift

observed: Privacy/local processing, ghost overlay, timeline, timelapse, 1080p vertical output and one-time pricing each appear in current competitors.
The five direct apps released since 2025 show zero visible US ratings in the current snapshot; this is low observable traction, not proof of zero use or revenue.
No reviewed direct two-photo listing advertised automatic subject/anchor alignment; automatic alignment is concentrated in progress trackers.
inference: The remaining testable seam is import-first automatic alignment quality without tracker complexity, followed by a fast proof/scrub and 9:16 export.
A generic two-photo transition maker or privacy-first progress tracker is too easy to copy and too close to current listings.
Transparent pricing is a trust choice, not a moat; the offer must be tested against a $3.99 one-time direct alternative and strong free editors.
